## Overview

A named group of menu items: `role="group"` labelled by its [`MenuLabelDirective`](/docs/reference/api/primitives/menu-label-directive).
Groups are structural only — they are never menu items and never take focus.

```html
<div qzMenuGroup>
  <div qzMenuLabel>Account</div>
  <button qzMenuItem>Profile</button>
</div>
```

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzMenuGroup`
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/menu/menu-group.directive.ts:58](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/menu/menu-group.directive.ts#L58)
